title: Brazilian Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Brazil, perfect for a chilly evening. The velvety texture of the sauce pairs well with the tender pork.

ingredients.name: Brazilian coffee
ingredients.notes: Used to add depth to the sauce

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Used to add intensity to the sauce

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: To cover the pork and vegetables

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onions and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, coffee, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Stir in the chocolate until melted and smooth.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
